Name: Wilderness of Paran
ModernLocation: Desert south of Canaan, modern Negev-Sinai region
Description: The great desert where Ishmael grew up and where Israel camped after leaving Sinai, sending the spies into Canaan from its edge.
BiblicalSignificance: Paran is the wilderness of waiting and failure: from here the spies went up, and here the people refused to enter the land.
